cues.en: In probably every video in this section, I have mentioned that each of the methods you learned about
cues.zh: 這一章幾乎每支影片都提到，每個方法

cues.en: have flaws or limitations, or at least can be tricky to interpret objectively because choices of parameters,
cues.zh: 都有缺陷、限制，或至少因參數、

cues.en: texts, sequence length, and so on can impact the quantifications.
cues.zh: 文本、序列長度等選擇會影響量化結果，而難以客觀解讀。

cues.en: Now, that is not because the people who develop those measures are sloppy.
cues.zh: 這不是因為開發者粗心。

cues.en: Quite the opposite.
cues.zh: 正好相反。

cues.en: Instead, it is because llms are very big and very complex, and human language is complex and sloppy and imperfect.
cues.zh: 而是 LLM 很大、很複雜，人類語言也複雜、雜亂、不完美。

cues.en: So it's just really hard to get one measure that works really well.
cues.zh: 所以很難用一個指標，就評估得很好。

cues.en: So what do you think is a solution to that issue?
cues.zh: 你覺得有什麼解法？

cues.en: I can imagine that you guessed that we could.
cues.zh: 我想你可能猜到，可以，

cues.en: One approach we could take would be to gather lots of individual quantifications and aggregate them together to create one average score.
cues.zh: 把很多個別量化結果收集、彙整，建立一個平均分數。

cues.en: That is the idea of superglue.
cues.zh: 這就是 SuperGLUE 的概念。

cues.en: And there are also several other aggregation approaches as well.
cues.zh: 另外，也有其他彙整方式。

cues.en: The motivation is that the advantages of some methods balance out the disadvantages of other evaluation methods, and so we should just average a lot of them together.
cues.zh: 動機是，有些方法的優點能平衡其他方法的缺點，所以把很多種一起平均。

cues.en: This is a very common approach when studying complex systems.
cues.zh: 研究複雜系統時，這是很常見的方法。

cues.en: You see it all the time in psychology research.
cues.zh: 心理學研究經常看到。

cues.en: For example, if you want to do a personality assessment, you don't just have one question that you ask someone.
cues.zh: 例如評估人格，不會只問一題，

cues.en: Instead, you have people self-report on dozens or maybe hundreds of statements about themselves.
cues.zh: 而是讓受測者對幾十，甚至幾百個關於自己的陳述，自行回報。

cues.en: And then the assumption is that any individual statement is not necessarily indicative.
cues.zh: 假設是，個別陳述未必有代表性，

cues.en: So you take a lot of them and you average them together.
cues.zh: 所以多問一些，再平均。

cues.en: And that is the idea of agglomerative approaches like superglue.
cues.zh: SuperGLUE 這類彙整方法，也是這個概念。

cues.en: It is a general purpose benchmark that incorporates a lot of different tasks for the model to do, and
cues.zh: 它是通用基準，包含許多任務，

cues.en: the final score reflects the average of lots of individual tasks.
cues.zh: 最後分數反映多項任務的平均。

cues.en: It's actually based on an older version of the same approach that was just called glue.
cues.zh: 其實源自較舊、叫 GLUE 的版本。

cues.en: And then they came out with super glue, basically just as a way to make the tests more challenging because the language models were getting much better.
cues.zh: 後來模型更強，就推出 SuperGLUE，讓測驗更有挑戰性。

cues.en: So I like the name Super Glue, but it's certainly not the only aggregation based approach.
cues.zh: 我喜歡這個名字，但它當然不是唯一的彙整方法。

cues.en: Here is another one which is often abbreviated as helm or h e l m.
cues.zh: 另一個常縮寫為 HELM，也就是 H、E、L、M。

cues.en: This one is also fairly commonly used, and you can see right here in the abstract that this task battery
cues.zh: 也相當常用。可以在摘要看到，這組測驗

cues.en: includes 57 targeted tasks for the model to perform, ranging from math to history to law, and lots of other topics.
cues.zh: 包含 57 個目標任務，從數學、歷史、法律，到其他主題。

cues.en: Now these are just three of the many averaging based evaluation methods, and I am not highlighting
cues.zh: 這只是眾多平均式評估中的三個，不是因為

cues.en: these three because they're the only ones or necessarily even the best ones.
cues.zh: 它們是唯一，或一定最好，才特別介紹。

cues.en: This is just to give you a sense of some of the options.
cues.zh: 只是讓你了解選項。

cues.en: That's really all I have to say in this video.
cues.zh: 這支要說的就這些。

cues.en: I'm not going to discuss the implementations, although basically every one of these evaluation methods has some Python library or API that you can access.
cues.zh: 不討論實作，但基本上每種評估都有可存取的 Python 函式庫或 API。

cues.en: I do want to make two final points though.
cues.zh: 最後強調兩點。

cues.en: First of all is that when you have noise or low signal to noise ratio, data, averaging across different
cues.zh: 第一，資料有雜訊、訊雜比低時，跨不同

cues.en: measurements or different types of measurements is a well established procedure in statistical analysis.
cues.zh: 測量、不同類型的測量取平均，是統計中很成熟的程序。

cues.en: Second, you should also be mindful that all of the nuances in the individual tasks still have to be considered in the aggregated measures at the end of the day.
cues.zh: 第二，也要記得，個別任務的所有細節，在彙整指標裡仍需考慮。

cues.en: Llms are so complex, and language is so complex that it's just very difficult to attach a single number
cues.zh: LLM 與語言太複雜，很難用一個數字

cues.en: to an LLM capability, just like it's difficult to attach one meaningful number to a human capability.
cues.zh: 表示能力，就像很難用一個有意義的數字表示人類能力。
